changelog_rationale: Prevent structurally incomplete governed SDK release archives by requiring current entry, reconstruction and durable delivery modules in wheel andsdist.
Prevent incomplete local license passes by inventorying Fabric gate binary and failing early when required Go/npm tooling is absent.
